regime_context: The detector shows an extremely narrow, one-narrative tape: Banks lead with a top score and maximum breadth, Coal is the only eligible challenger, and every other theme is ineligible under the trend gate. Crucially, the backtest verdict and gate_helps=false mean the trend discipline has NOT historically reduced drawdown on China A-shares (the tape mean-reverts), and the track record shows directional accuracy of only 0.337. This is a display-only, no-edge regime — the honest read is low conviction at best.
emerging_watch: Watch whether the Banks–Coal margin (currently 0.04) exceeds 0.15 in favor of Coal with Coal's breadth rising above 0.7 and its hurst_tag flipping to trend — that would be the first observable sign of a confirmed handoff away from the Banks one-narrative, retires the watch if Coal falls back below score 0.8 or breadth drops under 0.4.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the sole 'one_narrative' leader with trend health (hurst_tag=trend, durability_bar 0.83) and unanimous breadth (1.0), and rotation shows no confirmed handoff. The lean is momentum-continuation only, heavily tempered by crowding_z 1.85 (a size-down caution, not a fade) and the fact that on this market's history the trend gate does NOT cut drawdown.
evidence: rotation.leader is Banks; no challenger handoff confirmed
theses.dissent: Mean-reverting A-share tape: the trend gate did not hold here (gate_helps=false), and a crowded one-narrative leader at crowding_z 1.85 and one_narrative=true is exactly where reflexivity reverses without warning. Momentum rank-IC on this universe is ~0.

falsifier.text: Banks (512800.SS) underperforms the CSI 300 by 3% or more over any trailing 10-day window before the check-by date

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is the only other eligible theme and the rotation challenger, score 1.038, with the margin to Banks a thin 0.04. But its hurst_tag is mean-revert (durability_bar only 0.55) and breadth is just 0.5, so the trend-tag for Coal is itself fragile. Treated as the only legitimate second leg in a two-theme eligible set, not as a prediction of handoff.
theses.dissent: hurst_tag=mean-revert means the upward trajectory is not trend-healthy and could reverse at any point; the A-share gate historically whipsaws mean-reverters. A 0.5 breadth theme is not a robust rotation challenger.

falsifier.text: Coal (515220.SS) loses more than 2% relative to Banks (512800.SS) before the check-by date

theses.subject: Solar / Photovoltaics
theses.thesis: Solar sits at rank 21 with the most negative crowding_z in the set (-2.22) and score -0.698, ineligible under the trend gate. The avoid lean is specifically that this theme shows no leadership or flow concentration and is the structural laggard in a one-narrative regime — a direction away from exposure, not a short.
evidence: one_narrative=true means non-leader themes have no confirmation
theses.dissent: In a mean-reverting tape, the most detested, most under-owned theme is often where the sharpest snap-back originates; crowding_z -2.22 can mark capitulation, not continuation.

falsifier.text: Solar (515790.SS) outperforms the CSI 300 by 5% over any trailing 10-day window before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
